mode.description: Execution mode: Choose between Train or Sample

batch_size.description: Batch size for training or sampling

any_time.description: Frequency (in epochs) to save snapshots and generate samples during training

model_path.description: Path to the model for loading and resuming training. If null, training starts from scratch.

ddim_timesteps.description: If not None, samples from the ddim method with the specified number of timesteps

sampling_mode.description: Sampling mode: Choose between simple, conditioned (model trained to approach a condition), or guided (model trained unconditionally)

n_conditions.description: Number of ensemble members used for the conditioned diffusion

n_sampling_conditioning_sets.description: Proceed sampling n_sampling_conditioning_sets times, -> the final ensemble contains 16*n_sampling_conditioning_sets members

n_training_conditioning_sets.description: Number of conditioning sets to train with

n_members_dataset.description: Total number of ensemble members in the dataset

guiding_col.description: Column to use for guided sampling. Required when using guided sampling mode.

n_leadtimes.description: Total number of leadtimes per ensemble in the dataset

leatimes_conditioning.description: Use the ensemble leadtime as a condition

mean_conditioning.description: Use the ensemble mean as a condition

var_conditioning.description: Use the ensemble variance as a condition

predict_residue.description: Predict the residue of the members (members - ensemble mean) instead of the members

mean_var_dir.description: Directory containing the mean and var values of each sample of the dataset

bootstrap_conditions.description: Use different sets of condtionning members to generate the n_sampling_conditioning_sets samples

n_sample.description: Number of samples to generate during training

random_noise.description: Use random noise for x_start in guided sampling

output_dir.description: Directory where the output data is saved

csv_file.description: Path to the CSV file containing label data (required for guided sampling)

csv_val_file.description: Path to the CSV file containing validation label data (required for guided sampling)

n_var_in_dataset.description: Number of variables in the dataset

var_indexes.description: List of variable indices for input data

crop.description: Crop parameters for input images [left, right, top, bottom]

date_start.description: We start sampling from this date

date_stop.description: We stop the sampling at this date

invert_norm.description: Invert normalization of input image samples

stat_folder.description: Folder where offset and scale will be found

offset_file.description: Constant file for normalisation, linear offset

scale_file.description: Constant file for normalisation, linear scaling

scheduler.description: Use scheduler for learning rate during training

scheduler_epoch.description: Number of epochs for the scheduler to downscale (save for resume)

epochs.description: Number of epochs to train the model

num_workers.description: Number of workers to load data

guidance_loss_scale.description: Scale factor for guidance loss in guided sampling

beta_schedule.description: Type of beta schedule (cosine or linear)

dataset_handler_config.description: Yaml configuration file for dataset handler

P_mean.description: mean of log-normal distribution from which noise is drawn for training

S_churn.description: parameters for stochastic sampling - depends on dataset, Table 5 in paper

S_tmin.description: parameters for stochastic sampling - depends on dataset, Table 5 in paper

S_tmax.description: parameters for stochastic sampling - depends on dataset, Table 5 in paper

S_noise.description: parameters for stochastic sampling - depends on dataset, Table 5 in paper
